owners.rationale: PNG HDR umbrella facet: every tone-mapping path of the pinned reference. PQ and HLG over BT.2020 and BT.709 primaries at 8/16 bits, with RWTMO at the content peak (a positive cLLI MaxCLL, else a positive mDCV maximum, else 1000 nits; no tone map at or below 203 nits), including malformed, duplicate, late and zero metadata, ignored gain-map signaling and SDR controls. Exact equivalence classes and discriminating peaks are checked on both sides, and the test also runs the transfer anchors and the gain-map base/admission/precedence evidence. AGTM is unreachable from the pinned PNG codec. See docs/research/png-umbrella-facets.md.

PNG alpha and color-profile umbrella facets: 2,808 reference crossings of every accepted signal family (gray and RGB ICC v2/v4 matrix and LUT, gAMA, cHRM, the sRGB chunk, SDR/linear/BT.709/Display-P3 and ignored narrow-range cICP, PQ/HLG) with every sample layout, transparency form (intrinsic, key, palette, none), interlace and APNG container, in SVG, PNG and PDF. They cover the PDF grayscale soft mask, exact alpha and transparent RGB zero. Per-family precedence and unsupported classes are enumerated by the owned codec:png:color/icc/cicp rows. This replaces the earlier equivalence argument with vectors. See docs/research/png-umbrella-facets.md.

PNG limits umbrella facet: byte, dimension, pixel and work equality and first crossing for every layout, interlace and container (the validation boundaries), and spec 13.2 multi-crossing precedence: width before height before area, and the image side before per-identity pixels, over 8/16-bit and Adam7 sources in every format with exact reports and recovery. Projection-workspace, mask and aggregate boundaries are owned by codec:png:limits:projection. See docs/research/png-umbrella-facets.md.
